about: Builders of the Visa DS Bridge. builders.js is a function of the plugin toolkit; the core evaluates it on every build and adds its entries to the section builders. needs lists the library components it imports by name ("Page › Name" when the kit repeats a name); the server resolves them to keys from the inventory. A layout builder places the navigation and opens the content column: every section after it lands there, piece by piece.
source: layout.json and rules.json of this pack; kit VPDS Components › Application layouts, Horizontal navigation, Vertical navigation, Footer, Content card, Input, Button

sections.verticalLayout: Vertical navigation (242) on the left, content column on the right with the margin of the grid beside a navigation (24 at 1024, 32 from 1280); every later section lands in the column. {appName, items:[label], selected?, user?}
sections.horizontalLayout: Horizontal navigation (80) on top, content column under it with margin 24. {appName, items:[label]}
sections.mixedLayout: Horizontal navigation on top (global items), vertical navigation on the left (local items), content beside it. {appName, items:[global], local:[label], selected?, user?}
sections.pageHeader: Headline 1 title and an optional body over the content. {title, body?}
sections.contentCards: A row of Content card: Default on the grid, equal heights. {perRow, cards:[{headline, subhead?, text, action?}]}
sections.formCard: A white form card (Shape large radius, padding 24/40): title, body, fields (input | select | textarea with label, value, message) and the button row. {title, body?, fields:[], primary, secondary?, tertiary?, width?}
sections.visaFooter: The Default footer inside the content column, flush with its edges. {copyright}
